newsitem.title: USA: Royal Caribbean says Celebrity deal cleared.
newsitem.headline: Royal Caribbean says Celebrity deal cleared.

text.p: Royal Caribbean International said Monday it has received regulatory clearance to proceed with its $1.3 billion merger with Celebrity Cruise Lines Inc .
The transaction is expected to close this week. it said the signing of definitive merger agreement between the two companies was anounced on June 17.
The Royal Caribbean and Celebrity cruise brands represent a combined fleet of 17 ships and a capacity of nearly 30,000 berths, including Celebrity's Mercury, which is due out in October, it said.
Royal Caribbean said it has three new ships on order, including two 130,000-ton Eagle-class vessels while Celebrity has one.
